entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I'm not sure. I have this jersey I bought, and it's just not right. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you give me your name or order number?
Yes, it's under the name Alex Bell. I think that's right. I'm looking at the order... it was delivered about... oh, a month and a half ago?

Okay, Alex, I see your order right here. It was for the VeloFit Aero Jersey, delivered 47 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? It's just the wrong size. I thought I ordered a Large, but it's much too tight across the shoulders. I'm not sure what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex, that's what I'm here for. I'm happy to help you with that. So, you'd like to get a different size?
Yes, I think so. I'd like to do an exchange for a bigger one if that's possible. I just got so overwhelmed with the online portal.
That is absolutely no problem at all. I've just checked your order date, and you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can definitely process an exchange for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all. And since you're one of our VIP members, I'm going to process this with complimentary expedited shipping on your new jersey, so you'll get the right size much faster. I'll email you a prepaid return label for the one that's too tight right now.
Wow, that's amazing! Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Alex. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and enjoy your new gear!
